description: Hitte - Mensen met een somatische aandoening in verharde buurten (2020) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. This map shows the percentage of the group with a somatic condition living in the most paved neighbourhoods of the province of Zuid-Holland. On this map only the neighborhoods are visible where at least 60 % of the neighborhood is paved. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Heat – People with somatic conditions in paved neighbourhoods (2020)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Klimaatatlas, Hitte, Verharding, Somatische aandoening. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
